decisions: Qualified S11 because general-client TLS verification changes a fallback branch. Split the Google shutdown rationale from the unverified Meta premise.

Closed the configuration-only session-binding gap with native IPv4 and IPv6 sessionMatchesIp controls. Default checks reject wider/unrelated prefixes; original50 overrides change acceptance as intended.

Rejected a suggested new member-to-report/custom-field persistence trigger. The unchanged TYPE_SERIALIZED writer rejects that object-looking text on both versions. Direct synthetic legacy reads still demonstrate the new reader false positive.

Rejected a proposed entropy estimate: its mapped probabilities totalled 63/64. The actual deterministic mapping has 57 singleton, two doubleton and one tripleton symbols. No exact final entropy guarantee is published.

Retained the distinction between current active sessions and later persistent-login/signature continuity. A post-panel native config-generator control rejects the assumption that the installer automatically inserts globalSalt; no board-prevalence estimate is made.

Reviewed three additional delivered differences locally: video.js Flash fallback removal, Facebook query-component encoding, and replacement INSTALL-UPGRADE guidance. The live-manifest regeneration advice is unnecessary for deleting paths absent from that manifest.
Original50 regressions remain verified. This consultation does not approve candidate51 or XF2 or clear their separate full-source checkpoint requirements.
limitations: No live payment/social/captcha transactions or production deployment were reviewed. Initial packet omissions remain explicit. Both runners recorded zero tool calls; Claude reported a preliminary license read that is not corroborated by that metadata, and no discovered license fact was accepted. New chair follow-up tests and documentation notes were not sent for another external round. Raw prompts, responses, manifests and full audit stay temporary and are removed after synthesis.
